line: I left my husband after realizing love had become permission to disappear.
prompt: A 28-year-old woman with a slim build, shoulder-length dark brown wavy hair, warm medium skin, oval face, and small silver hoop earrings sits facing the camera in a tidy apartment living room. She wears a cream knit cardigan over a plain olive T-shirt. Behind her are a gray fabric sofa, a wooden side table with a ceramic lamp, a leafy potted plant, and softly blurred framed prints on a beige wall. Natural afternoon light comes from a window to camera left, with gentle fill light on her face. Medium close-up framing from mid-chest upward, static camera, shallow depth of field, realistic talking-head style. She speaks directly to camera, quiet and deeply honest: "I left my husband after realizing love had become permission to disappear." Natural lip sync to dialogue, no background music, no score.
